claim.claim-text: a blade portion (156) including a distal end (164) and a proximal end (166), wherein the distal end (164) includes at least two arms (168, 170), a first arm (168) that extends to a first foot (174) and a second arm (170) that extends to a second foot (172), wherein at least one of the two arms (168) is pivotably attached to the distal end (164) of the blade portion (156); and wherein the first foot (174) and the second foot (172), when configured in a closed position, form a capture element having a center aperture (176) configured to receive a neck of a bone anchor.
2. The anchor blade (14) of claim 1, further comprising:

a locking shaft (200) that engages at least one of the two arms (168) to maintain any one of (i) the first foot (174), (ii) the second foot (172), or (iii) a combination of (i) and (ii) in the closed position; and an enclosed channel (198) extending a length of the anchor blade (14), wherein the locking shaft (200) extends through the enclosed channel (198) to engage at least one of the two arms (168, 170).

3. The anchor blade (14) of claim 1, wherein the first arm (168) is pivotably attached to the distal end (164) of the blade portion (156) and the second arm (170) is statically attached to the distal end (164) of the blade portion (156).

4. The anchor blade (14) of claim 1, wherein the first arm (168) rotates in a plane parallel to the width of the anchor blade (14) such that the first foot (174) can be separated from the second foot (172) to permit passage of a screw shank, allowing the anchor blade (14) to disengage from the bone anchor.
5. The anchor blade (14) of claim 2, wherein the locking shaft (200) is engaged using a setscrew (202).
6. The anchor blade (14) of claim 5, wherein the setscrew (202) includes a threaded body (204) and a distal shelf (206).

7. The anchor blade of claim 1, wherein the first arm (168) is coupled to the second arm (170), and the first arm (168) and the second arm (170) are movable between the closed position and an open position.

8. The anchor blade (14) of claim 7 wherein the first foot (174) and the second foot (172) are configured to permit passage of the bone anchor into and out of the capture element in the open position.

9. The anchor blade (14) of claim 7, wherein the first arm (168) is pivotably attached to the distal end (164) of the blade portion (156) and the second arm (170) is statically attached to the distal end (164) of the blade portion (156).

10. The anchor blade (14) of claim 7, wherein the first arm (168) rotates in a plane parallel to the width of the anchor blade (14) such that the first foot (174) can be separated from the second foot (172) to permit passage of a screw shank, allowing the anchor blade (14) to disengage from the bone anchor.
11. The anchor blade (14) of claim 10 further comprising a locking shaft (200) that engages the first arm (168) to maintain the first foot (174) in the closed position.
12. The anchor blade (14) of claim 11, wherein the locking shaft (200) is engaged using a setscrew (202).
13. The anchor blade (14) of claim 12, wherein the setscrew (202) includes a threaded body (204) and a distal shelf (206).

14. The anchor blade (14) of claim 13, wherein the distal shelf (206) interacts with a proximal tab (212) on the locking shaft (200) in such a way that when the setscrew (202) is rotated, the distal shelf (206) exerts a downward force on the proximal tab (212), causing the locking shaft (200) to advance distally through the channel (198) and engage at least one of the two arms (168, 170) .

15. A spinal retractor for a maintaining an access corridor to a site along a spinal column on which a surgical procedure is performed, the surgical procedure including use of a bone anchor anchorable into a pedicle of a vertebra, the spinal retractor comprising:

a retractor body including at least one retractor arm, the retractor body being operable to move the retractor arm; an anchor blade (14) coupleable to the at least one retractor arm and configured to capture a portion of the bone anchor to anchor the retractor to the pedicle of the vertebra, wherein the anchor blade (14) includes:

a blade portion (156) including a distal end (164) and a proximal end (166), wherein the distal end (164) includes at least two arms (168, 170), a first arm (168) that extends to a first foot (174) and a second arm (170) that extends to a second foot (172), wherein at least one of the two arms (168, 170) is pivotably attached to the distal end (164) of the blade portion (156); and wherein the first foot (174) and the second foot (172), when configured in a closed position, form a capture element having a center aperture configured to receive a neck of a bone anchor.
